items.description: Role metadata (author, description, platforms, dependencies)
Handlers for nginx reload, fail2ban restart, ssh restart, sysctl reload
Role argument specs for fail-fast parameter validation (generate after defaults/main.yml)
Chef attributes converted to Ansible defaults (sites config, SSH hardening flags, SSL subject fields)
Entry point — includes security, nginx, ssl, sites task files in order
Security hardening: fail2ban, ufw firewall rules, sysctl kernel params, SSH hardening (PermitRootLogin/PasswordAuthentication)
Install nginx, deploy nginx.conf and security.conf, enable/start service, create document root dirs and static files
Install openssl/ca-certificates, create ssl-cert group, create SSL dirs, generate self-signed certs for all 3 virtual hosts
Deploy per-site nginx vhost configs, create sites-enabled symlinks, remove default site for all 3 virtual hosts
Kernel sysctl hardening parameters — rp_filter, redirect suppression, log_martians, ICMP ignore, IPv6 disable, SYN cookies
Global Nginx configuration — worker processes, connections, gzip, logging, includes conf.d and sites-enabled
Nginx security snippet — server_tokens off, rate-limit zones, client buffer limits, timeouts, SSL session/cipher config
Per-site Nginx vhost config — HTTP→HTTPS redirect, SSL, HSTS, security headers, gzip, document root, per-site logs
Fail2Ban jail configuration — DEFAULT bantime/findtime/maxretry, sshd, nginx-http-auth, nginx-limit-req, nginx-botsearch jails
Static HTML landing page for test.cluster.local virtual host — deployed to /opt/server/test/index.html
Static HTML landing page for ci.cluster.local virtual host — deployed to /opt/server/ci/index.html
Static HTML landing page for status.cluster.local virtual host — deployed to /opt/server/status/index.html
Molecule scenario configuration — delegated driver, local connection for AAP compatibility
Converge playbook — creates expected filesystem state under /tmp/molecule_test/ (nginx configs, SSL dirs, document roots, fail2ban, sysctl)
items.notes: Generated converge.yml: creates full /tmp/molecule_test/ directory tree with nginx configs, site configs, sites-enabled symlinks, SSL placeholder certs/keys, document root HTML files, fail2ban jail.local, sysctl 99-security.conf, and hardened sshd_config. All loops use loop_control with prefixed loop_var. All copy tasks include backup: true. All file tasks have explicit state.

items.description: No-op instance create playbook for delegated driver
Verify playbook — checks /tmp/molecule_test/ paths for nginx configs, SSL certs/keys, vhost symlinks, fail2ban jail, sysctl conf, static files
items.notes: Generated verify.yml: split into 7 plays to stay under 15 tasks per play. Plays 1-6 verify filesystem state under /tmp/molecule_test/ using stat+assert and slurp+assert patterns. Play 7 covers service/port/HTTP checks tagged molecule-notest (container-unsafe). All loops use loop_control with prefixed loop_var and bracket notation. No untrusted variables in fail_msg strings.
